test_title: PYST 63: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Even after becoming bankrupt, Charlie is able to __maintain an outward show.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"keep up appearances" **means to maintain an outward show despite difficulties or hardships.
 
• In the given sentence, **Charlie is able to maintain an outward show even after becoming bankrupt.**
 
• Hence, the idiom **"keep up appearances" **appropriately substitutes the underlined segment.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Even after becoming bankrupt, Charlie is able to **keep up appearances.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bring down the house:** To receive a lot of applause.
 
• **Bell the cat:** To undertake a risky or dangerous task.
 
• **Cut a sorry figure:** To present a poor or pitiable appearance.
